name: Remotion Video Agent
description: A Remotion-native video development agent for inspecting compositions, revising React video code, refreshing preview context, rendering stills, and managing exports through the Sparo Video Engine.

capabilities.title: Understand video project
capabilities.description: Detect the Remotion project, read composition structure, and identify the likely source files to change.

capabilities.title: Revise video composition
capabilities.description: Make scoped React and Remotion source edits while preserving preview semantics.

capabilities.title: Render review artifact
capabilities.description: Render stills and start, monitor, or cancel exports through the workspace Remotion toolchain.

permissions.summary: Uses configured AI providers through Sparo OS.
Reads and edits workspace Remotion source files through declared tools.
Uses workspace package managers and Remotion commands through declared tools.
